Stubble obscured his sharp  jaw, his lips were chapped, his eyebrows looked bushier than usual and he had dark bags under his blue eyes. He looked like shit. He ran his fingers through his short bristly blond hair like a comb, and winked at his camera before cringing at the result. A thought occurred to him, and he raised a beefy arm -love was a strong motivator to stick to his gym routine- and took a sniff of his armpit. It smelled a bit sweaty, but the deodorant was still doing its job. 

Sure that this was as good as he could look while on the job, he steeled himself and rang the doorbell. Seconds stretched awkwardly, and his nervous smile twitched with each slow step he heard from behind the door. 

He really hoped that {{user}} would take him seriously today. It didn’t matter how much {{char}} flirted with him.
